dataset: Synthetic utility operations; no customer or employer data

audit.contract: First occurrence wins; invalid values and unmatched keys are quarantined, not imputed.

sql:
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
 AVG(duration_min) AS avg_duration_min,
 SUM(CASE WHEN duration_min > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_sla
 FROM events GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
